theme.en: AI Compute Expands as Access Rules Tighten
theme.zh: AI算力扩容与访问限制同步推进

dek.en: Google expands its TPU lineup around memory bandwidth and confidential computing, while reported Nvidia cloud quotas would constrain Chinese access to overseas GPUs. ASML's higher outlook and Mitsui Chemicals' planned JSR acquisition bring lithography and materials into the same picture.
dek.zh: Google围绕内存带宽与机密计算扩展TPU产品线，而报道中的英伟达云服务配额可能收紧中国客户对境外GPU的访问。ASML上调业绩指引，以及三井化学拟收购JSR，也将光刻设备与材料供应纳入这轮算力扩张的观察范围。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Google Adds Confidential TPU 8tx and Higher-Bandwidth TPU 8i Max
title.zh: Google推出支持机密计算的TPU 8tx与更高带宽的TPU 8i Max

summary.en: Google's TPU 8tx pairs AMD EPYC Turin hosts with confidential computing, while TPU 8i Max doubles memory bandwidth for inference, ServeTheHome reports. The variants address two deployment constraints: protecting sensitive workloads and moving data quickly enough to feed accelerator compute. The bandwidth increase is particularly relevant to memory-bound inference, although application throughput also depends on the workload.
summary.zh: 据ServeTheHome报道，Google的TPU 8tx搭配AMD EPYC Turin主机并支持机密计算，TPU 8i Max则将推理内存带宽翻倍。两款产品分别针对敏感工作负载保护，以及数据传输能否跟上加速器计算速度这两项部署约束。带宽提升对受内存限制的推理尤其有意义，实际应用吞吐量仍取决于工作负载。

title.en: AMD Brings Project Zenith to Ryzen AI Halo with Up to 192GB Unified Memory
title.zh: AMD将Project Zenith引入Ryzen AI Halo，统一内存最高192GB

summary.en: AMD has made Microsoft's Project Zenith available on the Ryzen AI Halo developer platform, providing a preconfigured Windows 11 development environment. The Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495-based mini PC supports up to 192GB of unified memory. The release combines local AI memory capacity with a ready-to-code software setup, reducing the initial configuration work for developers.
summary.zh: AMD宣布，微软Project Zenith现已登陆Ryzen AI Halo开发平台，提供预先配置的Windows 11开发环境。这款基于Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495的迷你PC最高配备192GB统一内存。此次更新将本地AI所需的内存容量与开箱即可编码的软件环境结合起来，减少开发者前期配置工作。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Keysight Combines RF and Photonic Design for Tower Semiconductor
title.zh: Keysight为Tower Semiconductor整合射频与光子设计

summary.en: Keysight is bringing radio-frequency and photonic design together for Tower Semiconductor, according to a report carried by Yahoo Finance. A combined design flow could help engineers coordinate electronic and optical components earlier in development, making design-tool integration relevant to customers building mixed RF and photonic systems.
summary.zh: 据Yahoo Finance刊载的报道，Keysight正在为Tower Semiconductor整合射频与光子设计。统一的设计流程有望帮助工程师在开发早期协调电子与光学组件，为同时涉及射频和光子功能的系统开发提供工具支持。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Agni Semiconductor Raises $11 Million for Scandium-Based Memory
title.zh: Agni Semiconductor为钪基存储芯片融资1100万美元

summary.en: Agni Semiconductor has raised an $11 million seed round for scandium-based memory chips, Dealroom reports. The financing backs an alternative materials approach in memory, where device characteristics ultimately determine suitable applications. This is an early-stage funding milestone; production scale and commercial device performance are not established by the announcement.
summary.zh: 据Dealroom报道，Agni Semiconductor为钪基存储芯片完成1100万美元种子轮融资。这笔资金支持以不同材料路线开发存储器，其适用场景最终取决于器件特性。此次披露属于早期融资进展，尚未确立量产规模或商业器件性能。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Mitsui Chemicals Plans JSR Acquisition to Expand Electronic Materials
title.zh: 三井化学拟收购JSR，扩大电子材料业务

summary.en: Mitsui Chemicals plans to acquire JSR as it expands in electronic materials, Chemical & Engineering News reports. The proposed transaction would change ownership of an established semiconductor-materials supplier. For chipmakers, the practical implications would center on continuity of qualified materials and the combined company's investment priorities.
summary.zh: 据Chemical & Engineering News报道，三井化学计划收购JSR，以扩大电子材料业务。这项拟议交易将改变一家成熟半导体材料供应商的所有权。对芯片制造商而言，实际影响将主要体现为已认证材料的供应连续性，以及合并后公司的投资重点。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Nvidia May Cap Chinese Business at Overseas Cloud Partners at 49%
title.zh: 英伟达或将境外云合作伙伴的中国业务占比限制在49%

summary.en: Nvidia may require overseas cloud partners to keep at least 51% of their business non-Chinese, effectively capping Chinese business at 49%, Tom's Hardware reports. Such a quota would make customer mix a constraint on Chinese firms renting AI GPUs abroad, alongside the availability of the hardware itself. The reported measure concerns a possible partner policy, with its impact dependent on the final scope and enforcement.
summary.zh: 据Tom's Hardware报道，英伟达可能要求境外云合作伙伴至少51%的业务来自非中国客户，即将中国业务占比限制在49%。此类配额会使客户构成成为中国企业租用境外AI GPU的一项约束，硬件供给之外还需考虑服务商的客户分配。报道涉及可能实施的合作伙伴政策，具体影响取决于最终适用范围与执行方式。

title.en: Texoma Semiconductor Tech Hub Receives Nearly $24 Million in Federal Funding
title.zh: Texoma半导体技术中心获得近2400万美元联邦资金

summary.en: The Texoma Semiconductor Tech Hub has been awarded nearly $24 million in federal funding, KXII reports. The award adds public backing to regional semiconductor development. Its contribution to manufacturing capability will depend on how the funding is deployed and the projects it supports.
summary.zh: 据KXII报道，Texoma半导体技术中心获得近2400万美元联邦资金。这项拨款为区域半导体发展增加了公共资金支持。其对制造能力的实际贡献，仍取决于资金投向及所支持项目的实施情况。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 业绩与市场

title.en: ASML Raises 2026 Guidance as AI Demand Drives Capacity Expansion
title.zh: AI需求推动产能扩张，ASML上调2026年业绩指引

summary.en: ASML has raised its 2026 guidance as AI demand accelerates capacity expansion, according to TradingView. The revision suggests that AI investment is feeding through to the lithography-tool outlook. Customer investment plans and equipment-delivery schedules will help determine how quickly that demand translates into additional manufacturing capacity.
summary.zh: 据TradingView报道，随着AI需求推动产能加速扩张，ASML上调了2026年业绩指引。这一调整表明，AI投资正传导至光刻设备的业务预期。客户投资计划与设备交付进度，将影响相关需求转化为新增制造产能的速度。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: South Korea Targets Rebellions Chips on Nvidia's Platform by 2028
title.zh: 韩国计划到2028年在英伟达平台上运行Rebellions芯片

summary.en: Forbes reports that South Korea plans to run Rebellions AI chips on Nvidia's platform by 2028. If implemented, the integration would give Korean-designed accelerators a route into an established infrastructure ecosystem. The 2028 timetable makes compatibility and execution the next milestones to watch.
summary.zh: 据Forbes报道，韩国计划到2028年在英伟达平台上运行Rebellions AI芯片。如果落实，这项集成将为韩国设计的加速器提供接入成熟基础设施生态的路径。围绕2028年这一目标，兼容性与实施进展将成为后续观察重点。

theme.en: Precision and Placement Shape Useful AI Throughput
theme.zh: 精度与数据放置共同决定AI有效吞吐量

dek.en: The selected preprints connect low-bit arithmetic, shared compute meshes and memory-array placement to practical execution bottlenecks. Circuit entropy measurements and simulation-driven design tools broaden the reading queue, with modeled accelerator results distinguished from physical hardware measurements.
dek.zh: 本期预印本将低比特运算、共享计算阵列与存储阵列映射，同实际执行瓶颈联系起来。电路熵测量和仿真驱动的设计工具进一步拓宽阅读范围，并对加速器建模结果与实体硬件测量作出区分。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Atik: A Shared-Mesh Transformer Accelerator for RISC-V
title.zh: Atik：面向RISC-V的共享阵列Transformer加速器

summary.en: Atik uses one fixed-point MAC mesh for matrix multiplication and dense attention, accepts BF16 tensors, and streams online softmax without materializing the full attention-score matrix. In cycle-by-cycle FireSim evaluation, the 8×8 mesh reaches peak speedups of 31.5× for matrix multiplication and 225.8× for attention against a scalar Rocket BF16 reference. Sharing the datapath offers a concrete way to support both kernels with the same compute resources. The preprint combines simulation with standalone Sky130 physical design; its model-level speedups are hybrid projections rather than full-model hardware runs.
summary.zh: Atik以同一套定点乘加阵列执行矩阵乘法与稠密注意力，输入输出采用BF16，并通过流式在线softmax避免显式保存完整注意力分数矩阵。在逐周期FireSim评估中，8×8阵列相对标量Rocket BF16参考实现，矩阵乘法和注意力的峰值加速分别达到31.5倍和225.8倍。共享数据通路为使用同一组计算资源支持两类内核提供了具体方案。该预印本结合模拟与独立的Sky130物理设计评估，模型级加速来自混合推算，并非完整模型的硬件实跑结果。

title.en: Retraining-Free Accuracy Recovery for Analog Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: 无需重新训练的模拟存算一体精度恢复

summary.en: Input centering, array-local Hadamard rotations and shared calibration let pretrained models compensate for analog-array errors without updating their weights. On the evaluated ReRAM configuration with 6-bit ADCs, the preprint reports accuracy recovery from 37.4% to 82.9% for ViT-B/16 and from 27.0% to 72.2% for Phi-4, both within 2.2 percentage points of floating-point accuracy. The method could reduce the cost of hardware-aware retraining, with applicability dependent on the target array's error distribution and calibration conditions.
summary.zh: 研究结合输入中心化、限制在阵列内部的Hadamard旋转和共享校准，使预训练模型无需更新权重即可补偿模拟阵列误差。在所评估的6比特ADC ReRAM配置上，预印本报告ViT-B/16准确率从37.4%恢复至82.9%，Phi-4从27.0%恢复至72.2%，两者与浮点准确率的差距均不超过2.2个百分点。该方法有望降低硬件感知重新训练的成本，其适用性取决于目标阵列的误差分布与校准条件。

title.en: CAMP: Context-Aware LLM Weight Placement on 3D-IMC Arrays
title.zh: CAMP：面向3D存算一体阵列的上下文感知大模型权重放置

papers.authors: Orhun Görkem, Athanasios Vasilopoulos, Georgios Pagonis, et al.

summary.en: CAMP places LLM weights across stacked 3D-IMC arrays using a conflict matrix that captures contention among the architecture, network and inference context. A profiling-driven feedback loop refines the mapping to expose concurrent matrix-vector operations and improve resource use. The contribution makes weight placement an execution-scheduling decision, with benefits that need to be evaluated for each architecture and runtime context.
summary.zh: CAMP通过冲突矩阵描述硬件架构、模型网络与推理上下文共同引发的资源争用，据此将大模型权重放置到堆叠的3D存算一体阵列中。以性能分析驱动的反馈循环进一步优化映射，使更多矩阵向量运算能够并发执行，并改善资源利用。该研究将权重放置转化为执行调度问题，具体收益需要结合各类架构与运行时上下文评估。

title.en: Circuits & Reliability
title.zh: 电路与可靠性

title.en: Gain-Dependent Entropy in a Zener Avalanche Noise TRNG
title.zh: 齐纳雪崩噪声真随机数发生器中的增益相关熵特性

summary.en: This circuit study assesses five amplifier-gain settings and two coupling-capacitor values in a Zener avalanche noise generator, using 1.44 billion raw bits per configuration for NIST SP 800-22 and SP 800-90B evaluation. Replacing the diode with a stable voltage source at the same bias point reduces switching activity by about 97%, supporting avalanche noise as the necessary entropy source. A three-phase autocorrelation pattern associated with comparator saturation and recovery makes analog circuit dynamics a key consideration in entropy assessment for low-cost embedded hardware.
summary.zh: 该电路研究评估齐纳雪崩噪声发生器的5种放大器增益与2种耦合电容取值，每种配置采用14.4亿原始比特进行NIST SP 800-22与SP 800-90B评估。将二极管替换为相同偏置点的稳定电压源后，开关活动减少约97%，支持雪崩噪声是必要熵源的判断。研究发现与比较器饱和及恢复过程相关的三阶段自相关结构，说明模拟电路动态是评估低成本嵌入式硬件熵质量的重要因素。

title.en: AI Models & Inference Systems
title.zh: AI模型与推理系统

title.en: BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding
title.zh: BitDecoding-FP4：原生FP4 KV缓存解码

papers.authors: Dayou Du, Woon Yee Ng, Guangming Sheng, et al.

summary.en: BitDecoding-FP4 co-designs quantization and attention kernels to decode directly from FP4 KV caches while addressing query error, probability underflow and key outliers. Splitting queries into two FP4 tensors reduces the reported query-logit error from 60% to 1%; the system also fuses probability quantization into transposed softmax and stacks query matrix operations over paged caches. The preprint targets the accuracy and kernel-overhead barriers that can prevent nominal 4-bit memory savings from becoming useful decoding throughput.
summary.zh: BitDecoding-FP4协同设计量化算法与注意力内核，直接使用FP4 KV缓存进行解码，并处理查询量化误差、概率下溢和键值离群点。将查询拆分为两个FP4张量后，文中报告的查询logit误差从60%降至1%；系统还将概率量化融合到转置softmax中，并在分页缓存上堆叠查询矩阵运算。该预印本针对精度损失与内核开销展开优化，这两类问题会妨碍4比特缓存的理论存储收益转化为实际解码吞吐量。

title.en: CHARM+: Attention Scheduling Across Unequal Communication Links
title.zh: CHARM+：面向带宽不均衡互连的注意力调度

papers.authors: Xinhang Zhang, Boning Zhang, Chengchun Liu, et al.

summary.en: CHARM+ reorganizes sequence-parallel attention communication into levels and separates cross-hardware transfers from local communication to reduce synchronization caused by unequal bandwidth. Against Ring-Attention, the preprint reports average forward/backward speedups of 1.3×/1.7× on a dual-NUMA PCIe architecture and 2.8×/2.9× on a dual-node NVLink architecture. The different gains show why communication scheduling needs to reflect the actual interconnect topology; these are attention-algorithm results rather than whole-model speedups.
summary.zh: CHARM+将序列并行注意力通信重组为多个层级，并分离跨硬件传输与本地通信，以减少带宽不均衡引发的同步开销。相对Ring-Attention，预印本报告双NUMA PCIe架构上的前向与反向平均加速分别为1.3倍和1.7倍，双节点NVLink架构上分别为2.8倍和2.9倍。收益差异说明通信调度需要匹配实际互连拓扑；这些数字衡量注意力算法性能，尚不能直接等同于完整模型加速。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: SAFTAC: Simulation-Augmented LLM Training for Analog Circuit Design
title.zh: SAFTAC：以仿真增强大模型训练的模拟电路设计方法

papers.authors: Junsheng Huang, Yifan Sun, Zhuoer Zhang, et al.

summary.en: SAFTAC builds a simulation-grounded dataset of 8,626 design tasks across 10 analog-circuit types, including specifications, labeled ports, loads, testbenches and reference netlists. It combines three-stage supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement fine-tuning augmented by simulation feedback so open-source LLMs can generate and revise designs against explicit requirements. The work addresses missing training information for specification-driven design, while physical implementation and fabricated performance require subsequent validation.
summary.zh: SAFTAC构建了以仿真为基础的数据集，包含10类模拟电路的8626项设计任务，并提供指标要求、标注端口、负载、测试平台和参考网表。它结合三阶段监督微调与仿真反馈增强的强化微调，使开源大模型能够依据明确要求生成并修改设计。该工作补充了指标驱动设计所缺少的训练信息，物理实现与流片后的性能仍需后续验证。

title.en: TauLang: Explicit Space-Time Programming for Static Accelerators
title.zh: TauLang：面向静态调度加速器的显式时空编程

papers.authors: Xuxiao Yang, Junchi Wu, Yuqi Peng, et al.

summary.en: TauLang makes operation issue times explicit in a kernel language for statically scheduled accelerators, where cycle timing is part of program correctness. Its compiler checks timing relationships algebraically and jointly solves tensor placement and cycle scheduling with integer linear programming. The approach could make schedule exploration easier on TSP-style machines, with evaluation conducted on a cycle-accurate TSP-like model rather than establishing performance on deployed Groq hardware.
summary.zh: TauLang在面向静态调度加速器的内核语言中显式表达操作发射时间，因为这类机器的周期时序直接关系到程序正确性。编译器通过代数方式检查时序关系，并以整数线性规划联合求解张量放置与周期调度。该方法有望简化TSP类架构的调度探索，评估采用类似TSP机器的周期精确模型，其结果尚不能直接代表已部署Groq硬件的性能。

title.en: RoadBlock Models Microscaling Formats Inside Programmable Tensor Cores
title.zh: RoadBlock在可编程Tensor Core中建模微缩放数值格式

summary.en: RoadBlock is an open-source framework built on the RISC-V Vortex GPGPU that models custom microscaling formats inside a programmable Tensor Core. It exposes data width, scale-factor width and block size as parameters and derives per-thread metadata tiling, enabling perplexity and power-performance-area tradeoffs to include integration overhead. The tool supports format selection before committing to silicon, with its results serving as modeling evidence that still needs physical validation.
summary.zh: RoadBlock是基于RISC-V Vortex GPGPU构建的开源框架，可在可编程Tensor Core中建模自定义微缩放数值格式。它将数据位宽、缩放因子位宽与分组大小参数化，并推导每个线程的元数据分块方式，使困惑度与功耗、性能、面积的权衡能够纳入集成开销。该工具支持在确定芯片实现前筛选格式，其结果属于建模证据，仍需物理实现验证。
